notes.title: Two difficulty levels, Buttons, Background Music
notes.notes:
- There are two levels of difficulty "easy" (without timer) and "hard" (with timer)
- "Restart" button has been added
- background music instead of "nature sounds"

notes.title: "Level-3"-Bug & Information at End of Level
notes.notes:
- "Level-3"-Bug is fixed. Before, the next level could only be loaded after a repeat. This often occurred after the 3rd level. The several tests carried out revealed no irregularities.

- At the end of each level there is now information about the number of errors [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36865650/7d2e27b61fae712dd3903cfe88f3b88c22fdfb12.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36865650/10c7007da72682fba2dbaa833fb5c9c57d685996.png[/img][/url] and the time needed [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36865650/89dac874958f9f0b047ae6fc60b6e07c366dd414.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36865650/002374d7dc9e80f23f386189a8a9befd0fc1f5fa.png[/img][/url].
